portal_hypertension.title: Extrahepatic Portal Venous Obstruction: Revisiting an Old Entity With NewPerspectives.
portal_hypertension.journal: Journal of clinical and experimental hepatology
portal_hypertension.authors: Singh S, Yadav RR, Dhiman RK
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：肝外门静脉阻塞（EHPVO）仍然是发展中国家非肝硬化门静脉高压的主要原因，尤其是儿童和青少年。 临床提示：其特点是慢性肝外门静脉血栓形成伴海绵状瘤样变，导致反复静脉曲张出血、脾功能亢进和门胆病。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Extrahepatic portal venous obstruction (EHPVO) remains a leading cause of non-cirrhotic portal hypertension in developing countries, especially among children and adolescents. Characterized by chronic extrahepatic portal vein thrombosis with cavernomatous transformation, it leads to recurrent variceal bleeding, hypersplenism, and portal biliopathy. Advances in imaging and interventional techniques have revolutionized management. portal_hypertension.title: Advanced MRI methods for children and young adults with autosomal recessive polycystic kidney disease (ARPKD) to support future multi-center clinical trials.
portal_hypertension.authors: MacAskill CJ, Smothers JB, Kretzler ME
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：常染色体隐性多囊肾病 (ARPKD) 是一种罕见的遗传性纤毛病，发病率和死亡率显着相关。 临床提示：ARPKD 肾脏疾病的特征是弥漫性肾梭形集合管扩张（微囊），导致进行性肾功能障碍。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Autosomal recessive polycystic kidney disease (ARPKD) is a rare, genetic ciliopathy with significant associated morbidity and mortality. ARPKD kidney disease is characterized by diffuse kidney fusiform collecting duct dilatations (microcysts) leading to progressive kidney dysfunction. Patients with ARPKD can also develop clinically-significant congenital hepatic fibrosis and portal hypertension. Despite advances in clinical management, there are currently no disease-modifying therapies approved for ARPKD, and the development of clinical trials has been limited by the lack of sensitive, non-invasive biomarkers capable of detecting early disease progression in both the kidney and liver. portal_hypertension.title: Histomorphometry indicates distinct contributions of myofibroblast activation and sinusoidal capillarization to portal hypertension.
portal_hypertension.authors: Sorz-Nechay T, Hofer BS, Königshofer P
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 102）。核心观点：门脉高压（PH）是肝硬化的严重后果，也是肝功能失代偿的主要驱动因素。 临床提示：我们的目的是研究组织学肌成纤维细胞激活（α-平滑肌肌动蛋白：αSMA）和肝窦毛细血管化（CD34）标记物与慢性肝病（CLD）患者PH严重程度之间的联系。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Portal hypertension (PH) is a severe consequence of cirrhosis and the primary driver of hepatic decompensation. We aimed to investigate the link between histological myofibroblast activation (alpha-smooth-muscle-actin: αSMA) and sinusoidal capillarization (CD34) markers to PH severity in patients with chronic liver disease (CLD). Patients with CLD underwent hepatic venous pressure gradient (HVPG) measurement and liver biopsy. Liver samples were stained by picrosirius-red for collagen proportionate area (CPA) and for αSMA/CD34. Quantitative histomorphometry was performed on full-slide scans. 102 patients (63.7% male, median age 56.4 years, mainly steatotic liver disease: 58.8%) were included....

portal_hypertension.title: Long-term follow-up, complications and outcomes of Meso-Rex bypass for extrahepatic portal vein obstruction (EHPVO): a systematic review.
portal_hypertension.journal: Digestive and liver disease : official journal of the Italian Society of Gastroenterology and the Italian Association for the Study of the Liver
portal_hypertension.authors: Riva P, Pio L, Zarfati A
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：肝外门静脉阻塞 (EHPVO) 是儿童肝前性门静脉高压的主要原因，可导致胃肠道 (GI) 出血、脾肿大和血小板减少。 临床提示：Meso-Rex 旁路术 (MRB) 可恢复肝血流，但长期结果的报道仍不一致。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Extrahepatic Portal Vein Obstruction (EHPVO) is the leading cause of prehepatic portal hypertension in children, causing gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding, splenomegaly, and thrombocytopenia. Meso-Rex Bypass (MRB) restores hepatopetal flow, but long-term outcomes remain inconsistently reported. We conducted the first systematic review of long-term outcomes after MRB in pediatric EHPVO. Following PRISMA guidelines, six databases were systematically searched. Prospective and retrospective studies on pediatric EHPVO patients (0-18 years) undergoing MRB were included. Technical aspects, complications, and functional outcomes were analyzed. Forty studies (1998-2024), encompassing 1403 MRB operations...
